chunks: And it is narrated from Saʿīd ibn Yasār, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who has a share of water usage with some people in their canal, while they are partners in it. Then some of them become in no need of their water share—may he sell it? He said: Yes, if he wishes he may sell it for silver coins, and if he wishes he may sell it for a measure of wheat.

key_terms.شُرَكَاءُ: partners sharing ownership or usage rights
key_terms.شِرْبٌ: a share or allotted right of water usage

ai.seo_question: Can a person sell his share of water rights in a jointly owned canal?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the sale of a person's share in water usage rights within a jointly owned canal. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام permits selling that share, whether in exchange for silver or for a measured amount of wheat, showing the permissibility of transacting such usufruct rights.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3867 - It is narrated from Sa'id bin Yasar who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a man who has a share of water usage in a canal along with others, and they are partners in it. If some of them no longer need their share of the water, can they sell it?
Imam (as) said: "Yes, if he wishes, he may sell it for silver coins, or if he wishes, he may sell it for a measure of wheat."
